topic: Hogeschool is not a lesser universiteit
text:
A common misreading of the Dutch system by people outside it is that hogeschool means "not quite university". It does not. They are parallel systems with different purposes: the universiteit teaches the discipline and leads to a master, the hogeschool teaches the work and leads to a job, with four years including substantial placements.

Dutch students arrive at a hogeschool from HAVO and at a universiteit from VWO, and because an IB Diploma is compared to VWO, an IB student can choose either. That is a genuine choice and it is worth making deliberately rather than by default. A student who wants to be employable in a field rather than continue studying it is often better served by the hogeschool, and will rarely be told so.
